query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Pipedrive CRM records: find deals and contacts, update deal participants and primary contacts, log notes and activities, schedule follow-ups, inspect deal and organization custom fields, and bulk reclassify deals across pipeline stages based on contract timing data.
query_ground_truth.query: bulk reclassify Pipedrive deals across pipeline stages
query_ground_truth.intent: Bulk update and move deals across pipeline stages based on contract timing data.

request.query: bulk reclassify Pipedrive deals across pipeline stages

results.use_case: bulk reclassify Pipedrive deals across pipeline stages
results.execution_guidance: Found 3 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Pipedrive is a sales management tool built around pipeline visualization, lead tracking, activity reminders, and automation to keep deals progressing
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=pipedrive. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="pipedrive") to create a connection BEFORE executing any pipedrive tools.

PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_A_DEAL.description: Updates the properties of a deal. For more information, see the tutorial for updating a deal.

status.description: Status of the deal (open, won, lost). Defaults to open

user_id.description: ID of the user who will be marked as owner of this deal

currency.description: Currency for the deal value (3-letter ISO code)

person_id.description: ID of the person this deal is linked to

visible_to.description: Visibility of the deal (owner, entire company etc)

lost_reason.description: Reason for losing the deal (only with status=lost)

expected_close_date.description: Expected close date in format YYYY-MM-DD

PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL.description: Tool to get details of a specific deal in Pipedrive. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about a deal by its ID.

id.description: The ID of the deal to retrieve

custom_fields.description: Comma-separated list of custom field keys to include (maximum 15 keys). Use this parameter for faster results and smaller responses when only specific custom fields are needed.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated list of additional fields to include in the response. Acceptable values: next_activity_id, last_activity_id, first_won_time, products_count, files_count, notes_count, followers_count, email_messages_count, activities_count, done_activities_count, undone_activities_count, participants_count, last_incoming_mail_time, last_outgoing_mail_time, smart_bcc_email

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS.description: Returns data about all deal fields.

limit.description: Items shown per page. Must be > 0 if provided.

time_info.message:
- This is time in UTC timezone. Get timezone from user if you needed.
          - Always use this time info to construct parameters for tool calls appropriately even when the tool call requires relative times like 'last week', 'last 24 hours', 'today', 'tomorrow' etc.
          - Do not hallucinate the time or timezone by yourself.
